arxiv-2112-01146.title: Conversational Agents in Therapeutic Interventions for Neurodevelopmental Disorders: A Survey DOI: 10.1145/1122445.1122456 Conference: Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY Woodstock ’18: ACM Symposium on Neural Gaze Detection, June 03–05, 2018, Woods
arxiv-2112-01146.creator: Fabio Catania, Micol Spitale, Franca Garzotto
arxiv-2112-01146.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Fabio Catania, Micol Spitale, Franca Garzotto. Neurodevelopmental Disorders (NDD) are a group of conditions with onset in the developmental period characterized by deficits in the cognitive and social areas. Conversational agents have been increasingly explored to support therapeutic interventions for people with NDD. This survey provides a structured view of the crucial design features of these systems, the types of therapeutic goals they address, and the empirical methods adopted for their evaluation.

arxiv-2301-07173.title: Towards Voice Reconstruction from EEG during Imagined Speech
arxiv-2301-07173.creator: Young-Eun Lee, Seo-Hyun Lee, Sang-Ho Kim, Seong-Whan Lee
arxiv-2301-07173.description: Abstract Translating imagined speech from human brain activity into voice is a challenging and absorbing research issue that can provide new means of human communication via brain signals. Endeavors toward reconstructing speech from brain activity have shown their potential using invasive measures of spoken speech data, however, have faced challenges in reconstructing imagined speech.

arxiv-2301-13833.title: A Mathematical Model for Curriculum Learning for Parities
arxiv-2301-13833.creator: Elisabetta Cornacchia, Elchanan Mossel
arxiv-2301-13833.description: Abstract Curriculum learning (CL) - training using samples that are generated and presented in a meaningful order - was introduced in the machine learning context around a decade ago. While CL has been extensively used and analysed empirically, there has been very little mathematical justification for its advantages.

arxiv-2405-08081.title: Not-so-inelastic Dark Matter
arxiv-2405-08081.creator: Giovani Dalla Valle Garcia, Felix Kahlhoefer, Maksym Ovchynnikov, Thomas Schwetz
arxiv-2405-08081.description: Abstract Models of inelastic (or pseudo-Dirac) dark matter commonly assume an accidental symmetry between the left-handed and right-handed mass terms in order to suppress diagonal couplings. We point out that this symmetry is unnecessary because for Majorana fermions the diagonal couplings are not strongly constrained.

arxiv-2409-08184.title: Outgoing monotone geodesics of standard subspaces
arxiv-2409-08184.creator: Jonas Schober
arxiv-2409-08184.description: Abstract We prove a real version of the Lax–Phillips Theorem and classify outgoing reflection positive orthogonal one-parameter groups. Using these results, we provide a normal form for outgoing monotone geodesics in the set Stand ⁡ ( ℋ ) \mathrm{Stand}(\mathcal{H}) of standard subspaces on some complex Hilbert space ℋ \mathcal{H} .

arxiv-2412-07826.title: SALON: Self-supervised Adaptive Learning for Off-road Navigation
arxiv-2412-07826.creator: Matthew Sivaprakasam, Samuel Triest, Cherie Ho, Shubhra Aich, Jeric Lew, Isaiah Adu, Wenshan Wang, Sebastian Scherer
arxiv-2412-07826.description: Abstract Autonomous robot navigation in off-road environments presents a number of challenges due to its lack of structure, making it difficult to handcraft robust heuristics for diverse scenarios. While learned methods using hand labels or self-supervised data improve generalizability, they often require a tremendous amount of data and can be vulnerable to domain shifts.

arxiv-2412-17298.title: Prompting in the Wild: An Empirical Study of Prompt Evolution in Software Repositories
arxiv-2412-17298.creator: Mahan Tafreshipour, Aaron Imani, Eric Huang, Eduardo Almeida, Thomas Zimmermann, Iftekhar Ahmed
arxiv-2412-17298.description: Abstract The adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping software development as developers integrate these LLMs into their applications. In such applications, prompts serve as the primary means of interacting with LLMs. Despite the widespread use of LLM-integrated applications, there is limited understanding of how developers manage and evolve prompts.

arxiv-2506-11878.title: Orbital Pumping in Ferrimagnetic Insulators
arxiv-2506-11878.creator: Hanchen Wang, Min-Gu Kang, Davit Petrosyan, Shilei Ding, Richard Schlitz, Lauren J. Riddiford, William Legrand, Pietro Gambardella
arxiv-2506-11878.description: Abstract We report the detection of pure orbital currents generated by both coherent and thermal magnons in the magnetic insulator Bi-doped yttrium iron garnet (BiYIG). The pumping of orbital and spin currents is jointly investigated in nano-devices made of naturally oxidized Cu, pure Cu, Pt, and Cr.

arxiv-2511-08375.title: Demystifying QUIC from the Specifications
arxiv-2511-08375.creator: Darius Saif 1 , Ashraf Matrawy 2
arxiv-2511-08375.description: Abstract QUIC is an advanced transport layer protocol whose ubiquity on the Internet is now very apparent. Importantly, QUIC fuels the next generation of web browsing: HTTP/3. QUIC is a stateful and connection oriented protocol which offers similar features (and more) to the combination of TCP and TLS.

pmc-12451329.title: Eucalyptus globulus essential oil alleviates cold-induced ascites and physiological disturbances in broiler chickens
pmc-12451329.creator: H Mohebodini, V Jazi, A Ashayerizadeh, MS Salehi, A Kahyani, E Bidarnamani, F Sharifi
pmc-12451329.description: This study evaluated the efficacy of Eucalyptus globulus essential oil (EEO) supplementation in attenuating ascites incidence and physiological disturbances in broiler chickens exposed to a cold-induced pulmonary hypertension syndrome model. A total of 720 one-day-old male Ross 308 chicks were randomly assigned to six dietary treatments, each with six replicates of 20 birds.

pmc-12464152.title: Study on design and practice of PBL teaching model based on STEM education concept
pmc-12464152.creator: Zuhan Liu
pmc-12464152.description: As a new concept of engineering education around the world, STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) education has become the focus in academic circles. However, there are many realistic puzzles on how to realize the Chinese teaching of STEM education.

pmc-12505635.title: DEP domain containing 1: a potential oncogenic driver
pmc-12505635.creator: Yi Cui, Weiwei Ouyang, Daiqin Luo, Youyou Li, Chuan Tian
pmc-12505635.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDEP domain-containing protein 1 (DEPDC1) is essential for cell cycle regulation and is increasingly associated with multiple cancers. Accumulating evidence demonstrates that DEPDC1 is significantly upregulated in tumor tissues than in non-malignant tissues across 31 cancer types. DEPDC1 overexpression has been linked to poor prognostic in many cancers, including ACC, KICH, KIRC, KIRP, LGG, LIHC, LUAD, MESO, PAAD, PCPG, SARC, UCEC, and UVM.MethodsIn this study, we analyzed the differential expression of DEPDC1 along with the gene expression profiles associated with it.

pmc-12581806.title: Difficult Diagnosis and Management of a Torsion-Associated Giant Paratubal Serous Borderline Mass: Unraveling a Rare Gynecologic Pathology—A Case Report
pmc-12581806.creator: Kristabella Gianina, Anita Rachmawati, Bogie Prabowo Rahmarjanto, Gayuh Tunggal Rachmadhini
pmc-12581806.description: BackgroundParatubal borderline tumors are exceptionally rare, particularly when presenting as giant adnexal masses complicated by torsion. Their clinical and radiological features often mimic ovarian lesions, and diagnosis is often only clarified intraoperatively or after definitive histological examination. This report highlights the diagnostic challenges and fertility-sparing management in a young woman with a giant paratubal serous borderline tumor.

pmc-12774471.title: Physiological neuroadaptations in prefrontal cortical regulation of abstinence and cue-induced relapse to cocaine seeking
pmc-12774471.creator: Saurabh S Kokane, Chevin M Ray, Ayteria D Crow, James M Otis, Jacqueline F McGinty
pmc-12774471.description: Biphasic molecular adaptations in pyramidal neurons (PNs) projecting from prelimbic (PL) cortex to the nucleus accumbens (NAc) (PL→NAc PNs) are hallmarks of early withdrawal vs. later abstinence from cocaine. However, whether biphasic electrophysiological changes accompany these molecular adaptations is unknown.

pmc-13029899.title: Indoor Volatile Organic Compound Exposure Patterns and White Blood Cell Count in Korean Adults: Effect Modification by Smoking
pmc-13029899.creator: Yang Jee Kim
pmc-13029899.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are ubiquitous environmental pollutants, and mixed VOC exposure has been linked to systemic inflammation. However, evidence remains limited regarding source-oriented VOC exposure patterns and their associations with inflammatory biomarkers in the general population. Using data from 1812 Korean adults participating in the Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (KNHANES) from July 2020 to August 2021, we identified source-oriented urinary VOC exposure patterns through factor analysis, yielding combustion-dominant and solvent-dominant indices.

pmc-13688513.title: Common and Unique Etiological Influences on Personality and Personality Disorders in Youth
pmc-13688513.creator: Svenn Omar Torgersen, Eirunn Skaug, Trine Waaktaar
pmc-13688513.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPersonality and personality disorders (PDs) are closely related constructs, but the nature of their relationship remains uncertain. Dimensional models suggest PDs are extreme manifestations of personality traits. pmc-13691722.title: Comparison of Lower Airway Sampling Strategies in Children with Protracted Bacterial Bronchitis (CLASSIC-PBB): a non-randomised, internally controlled, multicentre trial
pmc-13691722.creator: Francis J Gilchrist, Ivonne Solis-Trapala, Mathew Aspey, Zoe Baker, Robert Bowler, Malcolm Brodlie, Seema Desai, Caroline Harris, Emily Hinton, Hemant Kulkarni, Simon Lea, Aviva Ogbolosingha, Ian Sinha, Joanne Stock, Will Carroll, CLASSIC PBB study group
pmc-13691722.description: BackgroundProtracted bacterial bronchitis (PBB) is a leading cause of paediatric chronic wet cough. Identifying the causative pathogen promotes antibiotic stewardship, but bronchoalveolar lavage taken during flexible bronchoscopy (FB-BAL) is the only validated sampling strategy. We prospectively investigated if cough swab (CS) or induced sputum (IS) was a viable alternative.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For the purposes of this subchapter, the term “insurance” means United States Government life insurance.

uslaw-usc-t43-s1457c.title: 43 U.S.C. § 1457c — Power of Secretary or designated officer
uslaw-usc-t43-s1457c.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s1457c.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 31 (Department Of The Interior). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior, or such officer as he may designate, is authorized to enforce and carry into execution, by appropriate regulations, every part of the provisions of title 32 of the Revised Statutes not otherwise specially provided for.
